original_method: Export immutable RAS/log/bad-page/CPER baselines, perform only the approved EEPROM preparation/reset/driver state, inject once at the exact mapped target, capture post-injection bad pages and CPER, execute one owner-controlled AC cycle, compare exact address sets after recovery and reconcile OOB decode with in-band CPER and the resolved error-field scenario.
manual_activity: AMD/FAE resolves one versus multiple expected CPER records and exact target; the platform owner approves destructive EEPROM/reset/injection/AC operations and supervises recovery.
required_inputs: Exact injection command/target/block/type and expected Bus-error semantics
Whether device 0..7 EEPROM clear is truly required, backup/export format and restoration limits
Authoritative CPER model: UMC ext0 On-die ECC Deferred, GC ext62 GfxGcError Uncorrected poison, or two correlated records
Secure Redfish resource/index ordering/attachment and cdump schema
AC control boundary, workload drain, boot deadline, independent recovery and final driver/RAS state
safety_requirements: Use a dedicated drained SUT with explicit approval and independent BMC/console recovery
Export/hash all logs, RAS EEPROM/bad pages and in-band/OOB CPER state before any clear
Never use hardcoded HTTP/IP, grep index inference, malformed SCP or plaintext credentials
Inject exactly once and AC-cycle exactly once; stop on unexpected Bus error/GPU/RAS/PCIe/power/thermal/storage or recovery condition
Do not retry, clear evidence or restore RAS state except by the approved post-export procedure

After approval, perform exact EEPROM/reset/driver preparation and one supplied injection
Capture command result, bad-page delta and securely hash/decode correlated OOB plus in-band CPER

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL SOURCE-CONFLICTED BAD-PAGE PERSISTENCE FAULT INJECTION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Model evidence as one immutable chain: baseline export -> preparation -> one injection -> post-injection address set/CPER -> one AC boundary -> recovered same-device address set -> OOB/in-band field correlation, with hashes and synchronized identity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure CPER discovery/transfer, exact set comparison, destructive-state accountability, one-shot recovery and explicit record-field resolution.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A CPER index increase or nonempty bad-page list cannot prove persistence; exact addresses must match across AC and both evidence paths must correlate to the selected scenario/OAM.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: EEPROM clearing destroys historical state, injection can destabilize GPU/platform, and AC cycling removes host control. Mixed CPER criteria cannot be guessed or collapsed.

review_improvement: Turns a compressed destructive flow into a one-shot causal persistence chain and exposes the mixed CPER fields before any unsafe execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: Persistence is address identity across a true power boundary, not merely equal list length. The pre-AC post-injection and recovered post-AC sets must be tied to the same GPU/card/OAM after enumeration can change. OOB index ordering can include unrelated events, so the attachment needs time/location/type correlation and a hash; in-band CPER provides an independent path. The UMC and GC field sets could plausibly be distinct records in one poison workflow, but the Master does not state cardinality, so choosing one interpretation would be an unauthorized engineering decision.
